visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoor hotel room with modern wooden wall panels and minimalist furniture. A young woman with long dark hair, wearing sunglasses on her head and a white knit cardigan over a crop top, addresses the camera. She smiles and talks with high facial expression variability. (2) The camera pans to a large floor-to-ceiling window revealing a vast beach coastline, blue ocean water with several ships, and a prominent suspension bridge under a bright sunny sky. (3) Back inside, a man in a black sweater with white graphic text and sunglasses stands next to the woman. They interact briefly with smiles. (4) Close-up shots of the woman's face as she demonstrates a foundation product. She holds a frosted glass bottle with a white cap, then applies the liquid with a black-handled brush and dabs it with a beige teardrop-shaped makeup puff. (5) A montage sequence shows her in a cable car overlooking the sea at sunset, followed by her returning to the indoor setting where she gestures enthusiastically towards the camera while holding the product.
